name: Everea
source:
A fellow vassal, the sassy Everea has been close friends with Aliya for several years. Though she goes through brief, spontaneous periods of air-headedness, she's generally a determined, intelligent girl who loves nothing more than a good fight, both physical and verbal. Those who haven't long known her tend to even think her cold as a result of her penchant for sarcasm and the way she seems to have little sympathy towards the injured and the dead, whether they be a fellow warrior or an especially cute monster. Perhaps this is a result of something in her past, which she refuses to say a word about.

[From [url=https://ebullience-games.itch.io/airis]itch.io[/url]]
